asset.description: Fog effect high-pressure pump, Zone B

work_order.title: 5CP6120 reseal: prepare parts, tools and isolation
work_order.reported_symptom: Water weeping at the manifold during operation; pressure drops after 10 minutes at full flow.

tasks.text: Confirm pump model and seal material from the nameplate
Isolate per site procedure and verify zero energy / zero pressure
Replace seals and valves per service manual
Refill crankcase oil; run-in and leak check
